headline: Clinton order changes an earlier order that set up a federal commission to study capital budgeting.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13037, which created a Commission to Study Capital Budgeting. That commission looked at how the federal government plans and accounts for long-term spending on things like buildings and equipment. The title does not say what specific changes were made.

who_it_affects.group: Members and staff of the Commission to Study Capital Budgeting
who_it_affects.how: The rules that govern their commission were changed, though the details are not given in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely on signing, October 29, 1997 (not stated in the available information)
